annotations.title: Find a vault by what it has done

description: Find a vault by what it has DONE rather than what it is called. Free. The filter worth knowing is `earned`: `short` returns the vaults where a holder earned LESS than the venue advertises — there are 18 — and `beating` the ones where they earned more. It matches only vaults whose realised return is COMPARABLE with an advertised one, 349 of 3,394 open vaults; a venue that quotes nothing or a share price that never moves is excluded rather than counted as in-line, so a short list here means few comparable and not few that performed. Call vault_check on a slug for the full answer.

earned.description: in-line, beating or short — realised against advertised, comparable cases only.

maxRisk.description: Ceiling on the published risk score. Scored for 936 of 3,394 open vaults; the unscored are excluded, which is not the same as scoring well.

minOwnShare.description: Floor on the share of the vault its leader holds, 0 to 1. Readable on Hyperliquid and Drift only — 584 of 3,394 open vaults — so a floor excludes every other venue, where it is ABSENT and not zero. Evidence of alignment, never proof: the holder can be a treasury or a custodian.

minTvl.description: Floor on stated size, in US dollars.

platform.description: A platform id or its display name, e.g. morpho or Hyperliquid.

q.description: Part of a name or an address.

name: find_vaults

data.description: Each with its slug, which vault_check takes.

fields.description: Which fields this tool kept from the endpoint’s own rows.

warnings.description: READ THESE: an `earned` or `minOwnShare` floor carries what it excluded, and the denominator is not visible from the rows.
